14 August 2026

Dear Mrs Kaur-Bramwell,

Damp and mould at Flat 12, Holly Bank House - outcome of inspection

Thank you for your letter of 28/07/2026, in which you reported black
mould in the main bedroom and bathroom of your flat and condensation on
the windows, and asked us to treat the matter as a formal complaint.
I am sorry for the distress this has caused you and your family.

Our surveyor, Mr Callum Pryce, inspected the property on 06/08/2026. His
findings are as follows:

1. The mould in the bedroom is caused mainly by a defective section of
   guttering above the bedroom window, which has allowed rainwater to
   penetrate the external wall.
2. The bathroom extractor fan is not working and needs to be replaced.
3. Two window trickle vents are painted shut.

We accept that the guttering defect should have been identified during
our stock condition survey of Holly Bank House in March, and we are
upholding your complaint at Stage 1.

We will carry out the following works:

- replacement of the guttering and treatment of the affected wall
  (contractor: Pennine Roofline Ltd), scheduled for Tuesday 8 September
  2026;
- installation of a new humidistat extractor fan in the bathroom;
- freeing of the trickle vents and a mould wash of the bedroom and
  bathroom, followed by redecoration with anti-fungal paint once the wall
  has dried out, which we expect to take up to four weeks.

In recognition of the delay, we will credit your rent account with £150.
This will appear on your next rent statement.

If you are not satisfied with this response, you may ask for your
complaint to be reviewed at Stage 2 within 20 working days of the date of
this letter. You also have the right to contact the Housing Ombudsman.

Please call me directly on 01924 496 233 if the appointment date is not
convenient.

Yours sincerely,

Joanne Whitlock
Repairs Team Leader
Northgate Homes Housing Association

cc: Callum Pryce, Building Surveyor
